name: @aponika/auth-backend
description: Aponika identity platform API — OIDC issuer, sessions, platform admin APIs

scripts.docker:dev: echo development > .compose-active-env && NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development up
scripts.docker:prod: echo production > .compose-active-env && NODE_ENV=production DOCKER_BUILD_TARGET=production docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:prod:build: NODE_ENV=production DOCKER_BUILD_TARGET=production docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production build --no-cache
scripts.docker:prod:down: NODE_ENV=production DOCKER_BUILD_TARGET=production docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production down && rm -f .compose-active-env
scripts.docker:logs:prod: NODE_ENV=production docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production logs -f app
scripts.docker:purge: NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development down -v --remove-orphans --rmi local && rm -f .compose-active-env
scripts.db:migrate:docker: bash -c 'ENV=$(cat .compose-active-env 2>/dev/null || echo "${NODE_ENV:-development}"); COMPOSE_FILES="-f docker-compose.yml"; [ "$ENV" = "production" ] && COMPOSE_FILES="-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml"; export NODE_ENV="$ENV"; [ "$ENV" = "production" ] && export DOCKER_BUILD_TARGET=production; docker compose $COMPOSE_FILES --env-file ".env.$ENV" exec app pnpm run db:migrate'
scripts.db:seed:docker: bash -c 'ENV=$(cat .compose-active-env 2>/dev/null || echo "${NODE_ENV:-development}"); COMPOSE_FILES="-f docker-compose.yml"; [ "$ENV" = "production" ] && COMPOSE_FILES="-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml"; export NODE_ENV="$ENV"; [ "$ENV" = "production" ] && export DOCKER_BUILD_TARGET=production; docker compose $COMPOSE_FILES --env-file ".env.$ENV" exec app pnpm run db:seed'
scripts.db:studio:docker: bash -c 'ENV=$(cat .compose-active-env 2>/dev/null || echo "${NODE_ENV:-development}"); COMPOSE_FILES="-f docker-compose.yml"; [ "$ENV" = "production" ] && COMPOSE_FILES="-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml"; export NODE_ENV="$ENV"; [ "$ENV" = "production" ] && export DOCKER_BUILD_TARGET=production; docker compose $COMPOSE_FILES --env-file ".env.$ENV" exec app pnpm run db:studio'
